title: Yes Bank First Exclusive credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A First Exclusive card offering elevated rewards, milestone vouchers, global privileges, and concierge benefits, designed for premium spenders.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: Medical insurance coverage of 25 lakhs for emergency hospitalization while traveling in flights.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: 25% discount on all movie tickets booked on the BookMyShow website or app, with a maximum discount capped at ₹250/month.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, report the incident to YES BANK Customer Care at 1800 103 6000 or 022 4935 0000. For email support, contact yesfirstcc@yesbank.in
